chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Kulayb al-Asadi, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the takbir over the deceased, and he indicated with his hand: five.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of Allahu Akbar in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.بِيَدِهِ: with his hand, meaning he indicated the number by gesture
key_terms.خَمْسًا: five, indicating the required number of takbirs

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are said over the deceased in the funeral prayer according to Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of takbirs to be said over the deceased in the funeral prayer. Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام indicated that they are five, establishing a legal ruling concerning salat over the dead.
